interface Left { value: number }
interface Right { value: string }
interface Both extends Left, Right {}
interface L2 { value?: number }
interface R2 { value: number }
interface Both2 extends L2, R2 {}
interface L3 { readonly v: number }
interface R3 { v: number }
interface Both3 extends L3, R3 {}
interface Both4 extends Left, Right { value: never }
interface Root { r: number }
interface A1 extends Root {}
interface A2 extends Root {}
interface Diamond extends A1, A2 {}
interface L5 { u: number | string }
interface R5 { u: string | number }
interface Both5 extends L5, R5 {}
interface L6 { m(): void }
interface R6 { m(): void }
interface Both6 extends L6, R6 {}
interface L7 { a: any }
interface R7 { a: unknown }
interface Both7 extends L7, R7 {}
interface G<T> { g: T }
interface Both8 extends G<number>, G<string> {}
interface Both9 extends G<number>, G<number> {}
interface L10 { x: { a: number } }
interface R10 { x: { a: number } }
interface Both10 extends L10, R10 {}
interface Both11 {}
interface Both11 extends Left, Right {}
